The handler returns 500 for a missing user. Current code:
func handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { id := r.PathValue("id"); if id == "" { http.Error(w, "missing id", 400); return }; user, err := store.Load(r.Context(), id); if err != nil { http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500); return }; json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(user) }
Fixed code (404 when not found):
func handle(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { id := r.PathValue("id"); if id == "" { http.Error(w, "missing id", 400); return }; user, err := store.Load(r.Context(), id); if err != nil { http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500); return }; json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(user) } // with errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) mapped to 404
